A Memorable Dinner
Jan 2024 • Solo
What a special experience on my last night in Da Lat. I sat at a large window and watched the lights come on over the city. I wanted to order something unfamiliar and traditional. I started with a beautiful fresh salad large enough to feed 4 and, with some trepidation and a large dose of curiosity, I opted for Traditional Frog Porridge. The presentation was dramatic as frog, veggies and an amazing sauce sizzled and simmered in a pot on a flaming platter. It was accompanied by a large bowl of porridge. The flavors were incredible.

Friendly restaurant and excellent food
Mar 2023
We had the specialties of the restaurant: Kale salad, Frog pudding and Hotpot with vegetables, shrimp and beef, and everything was just great. This restaurant is small, friendly, with an emphasis on organic food, which is absolutely what we wanted.
The frog may not be everybody's taste but it is mine and the sauce was really good. Hoang Anh's mother is a great cook.
I strongly recommend this restaurant and the efforts made to develop organic food in Da Lat and in Vietnam, which should be a leading trend in the future, in a place where vegetables are abundant but organic sensitivity not enough developped.

Delightful, delicious and amazing value
Sep 2019 • Family
Hoang Anh Restaurant was by far the highlight of our gourmet tour of Vietnam. This is an absolute must-visit for anyone who is interested in good food –not just good in taste but also nourishing for the heart and soul.

The spicy frog in fire pot was, hands down, the best frog dish I have ever tasted (and I’m French so I should know). My husband had beef in fire pot and loved every bit of it too. They recommended that we start with a house salad, which we did and will forever be grateful for. The sesame dressing was full of complex and joyful flavours.

The rice porridge was another delightful surprise. It felt both nourishing and soothing and was the perfect soft counterbalance to the spices in my dish.
Everything came in generous portions (we could not finish even though we really really wanted to).

Another wonderful part of the meal was the drinks: freshly squeezed juices in puzzling combinations (like kale and pineapple) that delighted the senses as well as energised the body.

The staff was wonderful: friendly, helpful and making a real and effective effort to speak English with us (even though they should not have to).

We loved learning that this restaurant was part of a whole system that encompasses farm, rainforest and other sustainable initiatives. They use no pesticides or chemicals in any aspect of their work and make everything by hand. They deserve all the support they can get (and if it comes by way of eating great food then everyone is happy).

Sometimes you hear people describe how wholesome, organic food feels great to eat and seems to nourish more than just the stomach. I had never actually experienced that myself and certainly not to that degree. I left the restaurant and that amazingly delicious meal with a wondrous feeling of well-being. It is not every day that you can get both a gourmet experience and such a sensation of lightness. Both my husband and son reported the same sensation.

The bill came to less than our breakfast had cost that morning. We just couldn’t believe it.

Whether you are after a real gourmet experience, great value or wholesome food for the body and soul, you should not miss Hoang Anh restaurant in Da Lat.
